generatedFor: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms

beats.label: S1 · A hedge knight's inheritance
beats.text: Dunk buries his mentor Ser Arlan and rides for the Ashford tournament with his horses, sword, and shield, meaning to enter as a knight himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Dunk's status, his lie about being knighted, and the tournament that structures the season.

beats.label: S1 · A bald boy named Egg
beats.text: A stable boy calling himself Egg attaches himself to Dunk, who takes him on as squire and dubs himself Ser Duncan the Tall.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Dunk-and-Egg partnership is the entire series; its formation is the load-bearing event of the season.

beats.label: S1 · Vouched for by a prince
beats.text: Prince Baelor Targaryen remembers Arlan and vouches for Dunk, letting him enter the lists and bringing him into the orbit of the royal family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Baelor's patronage is what puts Dunk in reach of the Targaryens and sets up the trial that follows.

beats.label: S1 · Aerion breaks the puppeteer
beats.text: Cruel Prince Aerion snaps Tanselle's finger over a dragon puppet; Dunk attacks him, and Egg reveals he is Aerion's brother, Aegon Targaryen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Unmasks Egg, triggers the trial, and defines Aerion as the enemy at Dunk's back for the rest of the story.

beats.label: S1 · A trial of seven
beats.text: Accused of kidnapping Egg, Dunk demands trial by combat; Aerion escalates it to seven against seven, and Baelor himself agrees to fight for Dunk.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the stakes and the field for the season's climax, and puts the heir to the throne on Dunk's side.

beats.label: S1 · Baelor dies for Dunk
beats.text: Dunk beats Aerion and wins the trial, but a mace-blow from Maekar has cracked Baelor's skull; the heir to the Iron Throne dies in Dunk's arms.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the realm's best future king and leaves Dunk carrying the guilt that shapes every choice he makes after.

beats.label: S1 · The road with a prince
beats.text: Maekar refuses to let Egg squire on the road, but the boy slips away and rides out with Dunk, and the two set course for Dorne together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season with Dunk and Egg as the wandering pair the series is named for, with a furious king's son behind them.

cliffhanger.text: Dunk and Egg leave Ashford as hedge knight and runaway prince, bound for Dorne. Behind them, Baelor is dead, Aerion is exiled to the Free Cities to nurse a grudge, and Maekar has just discovered his youngest son is gone.
questions: How long can Egg keep travelling as a common squire before his father drags him back?
What will Aerion do when he returns from Essos and finds Dunk still at his brother's side?
Can Dunk earn the knighthood he only claimed, now that a prince has died vouching for him?

characters.name: Ser Duncan the Tall (Dunk)
characters.line: A huge, low-born hedge knight who lied his way into the lists at Ashford and, against all odds, walked out a true sworn sword with a Targaryen prince for a squire.

characters.name: Egg (Aegon Targaryen)
characters.line: Maekar's youngest son, shaven-headed and hiding his name, now openly Dunk's squire and riding away from his family against his father's wishes.

characters.name: Prince Maekar Targaryen
characters.line: Egg's stern father, whose mace killed his own brother Baelor during the trial and who has just realised his youngest boy has run off with a hedge knight.

characters.name: Prince Aerion Targaryen
characters.line: Egg's vicious older brother, humiliated and beaten by Dunk in the trial of seven, packed off to the Free Cities to atone and nursing a hatred of them both.

characters.name: Prince Baelor Targaryen
characters.line: The beloved heir to the Iron Throne who vouched for Dunk and died fighting for him in the trial, leaving a hole at the top of the realm.

characters.name: Prince Daeron Targaryen
characters.line: Egg's drunken eldest brother, the one who first dreamed of Dunk; refused to fight in the tournament and warned Dunk that Egg must not grow up like Aerion.

characters.name: Ser Raymun Fossoway
characters.line: The Fossoway squire Dunk befriended, knighted on the field to fight in the trial, and now a young sworn knight married to the former prostitute Rowan.

characters.name: Ser Lyonel Baratheon
characters.line: The Laughing Storm, lord of Storm's End, who feasted Dunk, fought in the trial for him, and stands as his highborn friend in the stormlands.

characters.name: Tanselle
characters.line: The Dornish puppeteer Dunk fell for; her broken finger set off the whole trial, and she has fled Ashford back to Dorne — the reason Egg suggests they ride south.
